text: The Linus Pauling Award is an annual recognition of outstanding achievement in chemistry, presented by the Puget Sound, Oregon, and Portland sections of the American Chemical Society. The award is named after the renowned U.S. chemist Linus Pauling, who lived from 1901 to 1994, and was first bestowed in 1966. Additionally, another Linus Pauling Award is given each year by the Chemistry Department at Buffalo State College.
